name: Rook Ceph
author: Sextant
description: Rook Ceph clusters: Ceph health and its checks in plain words, capacity, daemons, the CRUSH tree and OSDs, pools, filesystems and object stores with their storage classes and claims, charts and problems. Since 1.1.0 it also manages them through Rook's own objects (upgrades, OSDs, CRUSH location, settings, create and delete), every change shown first and confirmed. In every language Sextant has.
